asked.item: Did I misunderstand what All LinkedIn does?
Does All LinkedIn send one post to both the profile and the Page?
Why only my personal profile got the post
How to publish the same content to both the profile and the Page

verdict.reason: The help pages directly state what All LinkedIn does, why the post went only to the profile, and how to post to both.

steps.text: Yes, All LinkedIn does not publish one post to every LinkedIn destination.
All LinkedIn only lets posts targeting any connected LinkedIn personal profile or company Page use the slot.
The destination selected on the post controls where it publishes.
To publish the same content to your personal profile and your company Page, create one post for each destination.
